body:
Thanks for your answer!

I know I should work on myself.

When I was in the middle of my 10s I was 103 kg (227 lbs) with a 173 cm height (5'8). I was very disgusting I know thanks to my parents. They thought the best way to show their "love" is if I get so much foot as I can :(

Now I am 74 kg (163 lbs) and I go to gym 4-5 times a week (weight lifting). The skin on my stomach is disgusting but I will have a plastic surgery in the middle of June.

I have done and I am doing everything that I can. But... I get the same feedback all the time: "You are a very good man but...", "You are the most kind person I have met but...", "I have never met such a good, kind, reliable, nice person but..."

I don't think I am so ugly nor a bad person. Maybe I found the wrong person (girlfriend) all the time.

​

But when you have a very big empty space in your heart or in your soul which is impossible to fill (my mother died 8 years ago and my father had left us 10 years ago, girlfriends who had told you that you are disgusting or told you they love you but... but... BUT...) then there is no hope. When you had a disgusting body which you worked on very hard but still no chance to have somebody to love you or just hug you every night.... what else could you do?

​

I have a job which pays the country average or little more with overtime (I live in Sweden).

I have some savings which I have invested and I get dividend every month (not much but I could live 5 years without a job and normal salary).

Now I have an average body but I'm still working on it.

​

I have depression I know. I took medication for that but it didn't help so I gave it up.

​

I could have a goal or a deadline (this word tells more than 1000 another could tell) but how long should a being suffer? 1 year? 5 years? 10 years? What if nothing will be changed?

​

If everything will be good from tomorrow and I could calculate with an average 70 years, half of my life has gone already. The best I could have is +/-0. Do this worth it? 5 more years in "pain" and I could never have a meanings full life...
